content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NIScPR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in CSIR NIScPR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies for Project Associate / Senior Project Associate posts in CSIR NIScPR Recruitment 2026. These positions are available across various specialized fields.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for CSIR NIScPR Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for CSIR NIScPR Project Associate / Senior Project Associate posts is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for CSIR NIScPR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for CSIR NIScPR Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates must report between 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Project Associate-I (PAT-I) posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Associate-I (PAT-I) posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT) at CSIR NIScPR?
faq.answer: The salary for Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT) at CSIR NIScPR is Rs. 42000/- +HRA per month. Other Project Associate posts have varying salaries.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifications required for Project Associate-I (IT/Computer Science)?
faq.answer: Candidates for Project Associate-I (IT/Computer Science) must have an MCA/BE/BTech in IT/computer science or an equivalent degree from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for CSIR NIScPR Walk-in Interview 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CSIR NIScPR Walk-in Interview 2026. All candidates can apply for free.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR NIScPR Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for CSIR NIScPR Project Associate posts includes evaluation of academic records, performance in a test, and a final interview. Candidates must excel in all stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi (Pincode: 110012). Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue address.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the CSIR NIScPR walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate, and extra passport-size photographs.
